metadata.title: CoreWeave Rallies, Lifting Cloud and Chip Stocks

content.text:
LIVE
Just In
CoreWeave Rallies, Lifting Cloud and Chip Stocks
CoreWeave shares are up some 12% after its earnings soothed investor anxieties around the AI build-out.
It's the second most actively traded stock on the Nasdaq-100 this morning. Other AI names are catching the tailwind, too:
🏭 Other "neoclouds," which lease data centers to tech giants, are up, notably Nebius.
